_description: Documents the 17 secret-pattern families covered by hook_utils.redact_secrets(). This file is a parallel reference for the daily analyzer and tests; the canonical source of truth is modules/hooks/lib/hook_utils.py (the SECRET_PATTERNS list). Updating regexes here without also updating hook_utils.py will silently desync the contract.

patterns.name: aws_access_key
patterns.notes: Access key id; pairs with a 40-char secret access key (not pattern-matched here).

patterns.name: slack
patterns.notes: Covers xoxa, xoxb, xoxp, xoxr, xoxs variants.

patterns.name: supabase
patterns.notes: Modern prefixed shape (replaces legacy anon/service_role keys).

patterns.name: openai
patterns.notes: Generic sk- shape; explicitly excludes Anthropic and Stripe prefixes via negative lookaheads.

patterns.name: authorization_bearer
patterns.notes: Authorization header. Catches most generic bearer tokens.

patterns.name: env_var_kv
patterns.notes: env-var-style KV assignments naming common secret keys. Conservative; over-fires acceptably.

patterns.name: password_flag
patterns.notes: CLI --password/-p flag with a value following.
